```yaml
name: Claude Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - '.github/workflows/claude-review.yml'

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest

      - name: Run tests with pytest
        run: |
          pytest tests/ -v

      - name: Run linting
        run: |
          flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
          flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics

      - name: Run type checking
        run: |
          mypy --package nemo_evaluator --strict

      - name: Run slurm executor tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/test_slurm_executor.py -v

      - name: Verify CLI argument parsing
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --help
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm --account test_account --partition test_partition --job_dir /tmp/test_job_dir --time_limit 01:00:00

      - name: Test environment variable fallbacks
        run: |
          export ACCOUNT=test_account
          export PARTITION=test_partition
          export NEMORUN_HOME=/tmp/nemorun_home
          export CUSTOM_MOUNTS=/tmp/custom_mounts
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm --job_dir /tmp/test_job_dir --time_limit 01:00:00
```
